claim_being_audited: The Actor’s recommendation to certify the model is compliant because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the remaining medical-device weakness can be handled through disclosure and monitoring.
decision_criteria: If evidence showed the limitation was disclosed and certification policy permits launch with that disclosed limitation, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats.

If evidence showed an approved mitigation or risk acceptance with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on scope.
If evidence showed the weakness is not material for the named launch use case, the concern would be reduced.
Absent those items, certification remains insufficiently supported under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Final model card or release artifact showing the medical-device limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Materiality determination for the implant compatibility weakness for the named launch use case.
Approval record showing certification was granted on a caveated basis, if that is the intended theory.
specific_concerns: The available summary itself says a named launch-use-case weakness remains in implant compatibility routing.
The policy text requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for caveat-free certification.
The mitigation artifact is described as a draft and specifically lacks an accountable owner and alert threshold, so the approval predicate is not shown.
No admissible evidence in this role shows that the required limitation disclosure was actually included in the model card or otherwise approved.
The Actor’s packet supports, at most, a conditional or caveated certification theory, but the recommended action is stated as certify_model without evidence that the condition was satisfied.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available evidence, rather than only potentially supportable if disclosure and approval conditions are met.
That draft monitoring/runbook materials are sufficient to remove the current disclosure requirement.
Any implicit claim that approved risk acceptance or an approved mitigation package already exists.
